name: HTS USDC Term Credit
purpose: A fixed-term Circle testnet USDC advance secured by an ATS-native hold, valued with the live Pyth USDC/USD feed.
extensionNotes: The on-chain principal is denominated in USDC token units and is valued with Pyth only for collateral coverage.
The recipe names Circle testnet USDC specifically and does not claim that arbitrary HTS assets hold a dollar peg.
